title: Remove redundant lookupSrd pass-through wrapper
description: Tech-debt review finding. srd/lookup.ts lookupSrd is a one-line wrapper over lookupSrdRecord that adds nothing, and both are exported publicly inviting inconsistent use. Drop one, and confirm catalogRecordsForKind and CATALOG_KEYS have a production consumer or remove them. Relates to loreweaver-2g7. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
